instruction: I want to enable the use of STATUS command for new mail notifications instead of examining folders. Could you help me configure Thunderbird to use IMAP STATUS for checking new mail?

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling IMAP STATUS command for new mail notifications. Original task sets mail.imap.use_status_for_biff to false, this variation requires setting it to true.
